name: v1.5.3
body:
### Changes in 1.5.3:

* Updated to DXVK 2.6.1 (#79)
* Added `dxvk.allowFse` to DXVK configuration to preserve exclusive fullscreen support

### Files

**vanillafixes-1.5.3.zip:**
This is VanillaFixes without any extra files. Extract into the game directory and use VanillaFixes.exe to launch the game.

**vanillafixes-1.5.3-dxvk.zip:**
This version includes a copy of [DXVK 2.6.1](https://github.com/doitsujin/dxvk). DXVK is recommended for the best performance. 

### If your antivirus blocks VanillaFixes:
Some antiviruses detect the launcher as a malicious file: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/72ea02aa34b61675d6f9ffc99fc64bc3d0c3e68e139f3f885eb04cac5167bc07

This is a false positive that occurs because the launcher injects a DLL into another program (WoW.exe). The function causing the false positive can be found [here](https://github.com/hannesmann/vanillafixes/blob/v1.5.3/src/loader.c#L156). All code for VanillaFixes is open source and can be built yourself if you prefer.
